comparison.objective: Candidate removes open cartons while allowing closed cartons to continue; PR-1805 locks a bicycle wheel to a stand.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires moving interception, flap-clear sidewall support and spill-free placement. PR-1805 requires threading a shackle through constrained geometry and angled bent-foot crossbar engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades classification-dependent passage or reject placement with content retention. PR-1805 grades correct enclosure of both rim and stand, mechanical latching, release and stillness.
comparison.reason: The lock task tests constrained threading and staged mechanical engagement, not condition-based conveyor rejection. No material rubric detail is missing.
